name: flashlight
description: Battery-powered handheld flashlight: TURN it ON to see in dark rooms, OFF to save the cell (bare FLASHLIGHT toggles), RELOAD it with a fresh battery. A lit flashlight raises how brightly the holder perceives an otherwise dim/dark zone; the battery drains a minute at a time and dies when empty.
inputMatchers: turn|switch on|off <flashlight|torch> (either word order) — a matcher because `turn`/`switch` belong to furniture and flight; only claims input naming a flashlight or torch.
